SOURCE_RECEIPT.capture: OAuth client credentials; products search with filter.term and filter.locationId; ZIP entered per run.
SOURCE_RECEIPT.local_evidence: Local run with ZIP 29072 and terms milk/eggs/bread: 36 promoted products; catalog later showed 77 Kroger rows across runs.
SOURCE_RECEIPT.variant_policy: First priced item per product; productId dedupe; ZIP and location stored on each row.
SOURCE_RECEIPT.limitations: Store-specific prices and availability; search is term-based, not a universal on-sale feed.

PAGING_RECEIPT.strategy: Search terms with filter.limit; no category census claim.

PRICE_EXTRACTION_RECEIPT.current_price_role: Promo price when greater than zero and below regular; otherwise regular.
PRICE_EXTRACTION_RECEIPT.regular_price_role: Retailer regular price for the selected location.
PRICE_EXTRACTION_RECEIPT.rejections: Products without a regular price or without a promoted price are skipped.

RIGHTS_RECEIPT.note: User-supplied OAuth credentials; store-specific use, retention and redistribution rights remain to be reviewed.
